jobs.title: Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
This is an analyst-level position on the MENA investment team of a global capital formation team
focused on venture capital in emerging markets. The role is based in the Middle East or North Africa and is full-time.

The Role

The Investment Analyst works across deal execution, portfolio management, and stakeholder engagement within the MENA region. The position involves a high degree of autonomy from an early stage, with structured support and training during the first months. The analyst represents the investment team locally and works directly with founders across the portfolio.

Responsibilities

Conduct due diligence and execute investment contracts for prospective deals.
Support founders with corporate governance and fundraising readiness, including investment decks, financial models, and data rooms.
Research, analyse, and document steps of the investment process to inform internal decision-making.
Maintain accurate investment data, metrics, and files for existing and prospective deals.
Monitor portfolio companies, track key business metrics, and support their fundraising efficacy.
Track market developments, competitor activity, and technology trends relevant to current and prospective investments.
Build and maintain relationships with portfolio founders, co-investors, and ecosystem partners.
Collaborate with the broader network of mentors, advisors, and stakeholders to support portfolio startups on fundraising and business development.
Participate actively in startup communities across the region.

First-Month Milestones

Complete investment processing training.
Become familiar with the team\'s programmes, portfolio companies, and platform structure.
Onboard a new company and document, analyse, and present steps of the investment management process.
Take ownership of portfolio company communications proactively.

Three-Month Milestones

Understand the investment strategy and conduct independent research on potential investments.
Write investment committee memos.
Analyse portfolio follow-on round terms and fund ownership.
Execute at least two investment deals under direct supervision.

Nine-Month Milestones

Execute investment deals independently with minimal supervision.
Prepare startups for fundraising, including pitch materials, data rooms, and financial models.
Establish a personal network of investors in the region.
Receive confirmed feedback from portfolio companies as a trusted resource.

Required Profile

Bachelor\'s degree in any discipline.
One to two years of professional experience; strong internship or fellowship experience is acceptable.
Fluency in both English and Arabic is required.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects to completion with limited direction.
Strong attention to detail and capacity for independent research.
Analytical and problem-solving skills with a systematic approach.
Demonstrated use of AI tools in a professional or academic context.
Genuine interest in startups and startup ecosystems.

Application Process

Submit your CV and cover letter using the application form linked in the job posting. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. All submissions must go through the form.

About MENA Careers

MENA Careers is a private equity career platform built for candidates who want better access to recruiters, live opportunities, and market insight. It helps members discover relevant private equity roles, find specialist recruiters, and navigate the search with sharper direction across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Doha, London, and Singapore. MENA Careers is designed to make the private equity search more focused, more informed, and more effective. For more information, visit joinsenna.com.
